title: Pregnant Solo #28
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Indian woman, an adult, in her mid 30s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her upper silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward just as prominently, the bust and the belly together forming the two dominant curves of her frame. Round hips and soft thighs continue below. Her head looks small between her massive bust and belly. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, braided hair, real pores, real living eyes, 8 bars piercings set with diamonds in silver-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of rose-gold a necklace. Full body painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework, an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the pattern reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps, wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of fine filigree linework wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's natural centrepiece, the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme gold extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
